name: Lightning Decision Jam (Framing)
deliverable: Rapid identification and re-framing of key operational blockers

steps.text: Set the timer and have everyone silently write the blockers they hit in this work, one per note.
Post, read, and dot-vote the blockers; keep the three the room feels most.
Rewrite each kept blocker as a How Might We question that points at the user's need.
Silently add solutions to the reframed questions, then vote again for the strongest.
Close by naming the one reframe the group will carry into the next working session.

failure: The room votes on blockers but never reframes them, so the session ends with the same complaints it started with and no new opening.
intervention: Take the top blocker and ask what opportunity hides in it; write the How Might We question on the board and make the room solve that instead.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: Developed by AJ&Smart as a rapid workshop format; no single canonical publication.
